breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous claim that the principal directions remain aligned with the original axes and that the principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0. Instead, it instructs to 'Calculate the two principal stresses (σ1, σ2) accounting for σx, σy, and τxy,' which properly acknowledges that the principal stresses must be computed using the full plane stress transformation formula (including the nonzero shear stress τxy), matching the ground truth prompt.
